}}'''Floran Gelb''' is a sailor, formerly a crew member aboard [[Bayle Domon]]'s ship, [[Spray]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Floran Gelb}}

== Appearance ==
He is a narrow faced man with a long nose.

==Activities==
He failed to keep watch during that vulnerable night when the Spray was attacked by [[Trollocs]]. This was the same night that [[Thom Merrilin]], [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] arrived onboard, under attack.{{ref/book|1|20}}

After Gelb tried to turn the crew against the three travelers, Domon discharged him from his crew in [[Whitebridge]]. He gave Rand and the others a look of pure hatred as he left.{{ref/book|1|26}}

He later turned up in [[Tanchico]], working with [[Egeanin]] to recover ''[[a'dam]]'' and women who could channel.{{ref/book|4|38}} He and his men try to capture [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]]. Egeanin steps in to help the two girls and ends up beating up Gelb and his men.{{ref/book|4|46}}
